scenarios.name: Decline removal of duplicate model-state member names

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user creates an undimensioned rectangular sketch and extrudes it 1 in with zero taper
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State
the user creates a fourth model state named Model State1 and reactivates Copy State
the user opens the model-state table
The MCAD Software has a model-state table with members Capture State and Model State1
the user changes the Model State1 member cell to "Capture State" and presses Enter
both matching member-name cells are highlighted yellow
a warning identifies the duplicate name and says duplicates will be removed if the user continues
the warning offers Yes and No
the table remains open with both duplicate names highlighted
the table closes without accepting the rename
